name: x-feed-lens
description: Chrome MV3 extension: one-click feed context for X posts, with a local multilingual text encoder.

scripts.eval:semantic: npm run build && node scripts/semantic-eval.mjs browser
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/pw.mjs test
scripts.bench: npm run build && node scripts/pw.mjs test --config playwright.bench.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run eval:semantic && node scripts/pw.mjs test
